chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya, raising it up to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Sunnah upon the people of the cities is to exit their cities on the two Eids, except for the people of Mecca, for they pray in the Sacred Mosque.

key_terms.السُّنَّةُ: The established prophetic practice or custom
key_terms.الْعِيدَيْنِ: The two Eids (Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha)

ai.seo_question: Where should Muslims perform the Eid prayer according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), highlighting the jurisprudential distinction between the general practice of congregating in open fields (musalla) and the specific tradition of Mecca’s residents praying within the Sacred Mosque. This exception underscores the unique sanctity of the Haram, where the Prophet (PBUH) and Imams often prayed, thereby linking the Eid celebration directly to the holiest site in Islam rather than a peripheral gathering place.
